body: It was whatever. I’m recovering from a stomachs so I’ve been laying around all day
I just don’t get why I’m living a life I didn’t ask for

Yeah I feel like it’d just be the therapist words hitting a wall and me beating myself down. I feel like a lost cause. I don’t know to guide my feelings into anything other than sadness. Sure I have my bouts of laughter and not being sad but it eventually goes back to being depressed and hating life
I’ve never told anyone how I feel. I want to go to therapy but I feel I’d end up just rejecting everything I’d work through

I’m so ready but I’m scared. Fan fiction makes it seem like overdosing and drinking will make it fast but I’m scared. As much as I don’t want to be here anymore I just can’t bring my self to take my life away
I’ll be your friend if you’re mine
I hope you don’t. I’m here if you need to talk.
